title: Gnocchi with Brown Butter and Sage
summary: Gnocchi tossed in nutty brown butter with crisp sage leaves and Parmesan. Ten minutes, for one.

steps.text: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil and cook the gnocchi as the packet says, usually until they float. Keep a small cup of the cooking water before draining them.
Meanwhile, put a frying pan over a medium-low heat, add the butter and let it melt and foam.
Add the sage leaves and cook for {timer:1-2}, turning them once, until the butter has golden-brown flecks and smells nutty. Turn the heat down if it darkens too quickly.
Add the drained gnocchi to the pan and toss gently for {timer:1-2} to coat them in the sage butter. For a golden outside, leave them undisturbed a little longer before tossing.
Turn the heat to low, add 1 tbsp of the cooking water and toss to bring the butter together into a light sauce. Add a little more water if needed.
Take the pan off the heat and add the Parmesan, black pepper and lemon zest, if using. Toss until glossy, and taste before adding any salt: Parmesan is already salty.
Serve straight away, while the sage is crisp and the sauce glossy.

tips: Do not skip browning the butter, but watch it closely: the difference between nutty brown butter and burnt butter is only a few seconds.
Use 15-20 g Parmesan and 1-2 tbsp of the cooking water.
